svg.title: How Midterm House Seat Losses Compare
svg.desc: Net House seats for the sitting president's party: 1994 minus 54; 1998 plus 4; 2002 plus 8; 2006 minus 30; 2010 minus 63; 2018 minus 41. The outlined, hatched 2026 bar shows minus 35 net called flips in the unverified November 4 snapshot, not a final result or projection. These are seats, not vote swings.
svg.text: How Midterm House Seat Losses Compare
President's party / Seats, not vote swing
